parsed_json.up: Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with the indication 'hypertension'. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join drug_indication to atc_classification on level5 to filter by the ATC code for hypertension (C02, C03, C07, C08, or C09). Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles (via INNER JOIN compound_structures), indication_curie (EFO ID), indication_label (EFO term), and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
